name: Stocknudge – Low Stock Alerts for Slack
author: suporttis

sections.description:
Stocknudge watches your WooCommerce inventory and messages your team in Slack the moment a product or variation drops to the critical limit you choose.

  • Set a critical limit per product or variation (Inventory tab)
  • One alert per drop: no spam until stock recovers and falls again
  • Alerts go to your own Slack channel through an Incoming Webhook
  • Alert includes store, product, available stock, limit, time and a “Restock product” button
  • Alerts are sent after the page response, so checkout is never slowed down
  • Unlimited stock rules, no account needed
  • Want email, Microsoft Teams or WhatsApp alerts too? A separate paid add-on, Stocknudge Pro, adds them
  • Translation-ready: translations are provided through translate.wordpress.org

Stocknudge never reads customers or orders.

External services

This plugin sends a message to the Slack Incoming Webhook URL you configure, only when a product reaches its critical stock limit and when you press “Send test message”. The message contains your store domain, the product name, the available stock, the limit and the time. No customer or order data is sent. Slack terms: https://slack.com/terms-of-service/user and privacy policy: https://slack.com/trust/privacy/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Stocknudge and paste your Slack Incoming Webhook URL.
  3. Edit a product, open the Inventory tab, enable stock management and set the “Stocknudge critical limit”.
sections.faq:
Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Set the limit on each variation that manages its own stock.

What does this plugin include?

Everything described above, with no limits on the number of products or variations. Alerts are delivered to Slack.

What does Stocknudge Pro add?

Stocknudge Pro is a separate add-on, sold on our website, that sends the same alerts by email, Microsoft Teams and WhatsApp. This plugin works fully on its own without it.

Does it read my customers or orders?

No.
